{"kind":"hv-full-content-r7","artifact":"verdict.md","sequence":8,"total":13,"artifactSha256":"8E36FE96DF037CAB1E56DFE2ACFBE22AB5764773E1B7B5C95C894334E118C9F9","content":"N-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:91, Marker-relative windows and process-local history. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: D5 aligns each stream to its own checkpoint/load marker while retaining raw indices. It requires own BA-derived AEC from the first offset, including a first stolen cycle, and rejects reused history, dropped prefixes and warm-up trimming. Existing bus-adapter/obs-emitter state is process-local. Rationale: VSF does not serialize wrapper-local history; equality must be demonstrated, not synthesized by trimming until output agrees. Required outcome: Keep first-stolen-cycle, stale-history and marker-boundary controls; fail on a real discrepancy.

**N11 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:81, Detector initialization, failure and inertness. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: D2 covers combined resolver plus xvic availability/create paths, xvic-first/x64-first fresh processes, aliases/fallbacks and failed loads. Audit environment is set before discovery; missing/unwritable logs fail loudly, separate positive logs do not contaminate the real gate. Rationale: Availability/path probing is not itself a successful DLL load. The detector must expose specified attempts while staying out of warmed cycle paths. Required outcome: Keep all failure/fallback controls and explicit no-log behavior when unset.

**N12 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:63, Authorized R15 real-input amendment. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: All three VSFs were parsed: two identical real MAINCPU 1.2 files and one real 1.4 file, no real 1.3. R15 verbatim changes real AC1 inputs to 1.2/1.4; D1 owns wrapper update/readback and D5 real resume/native-written 1.4 round-trip. Rationale: This is an explicit semantic amendment, not synthetic 1.3 presented as external provenance. Synthetic 1.3 byte coverage remains required. N26 addresses propagation cleanup without reducing this obligation. Required outcome: Read back exact amended AC1, unchanged normalization coverage and reference-only AC2 before acceptance.

**N13 PASS** (medium), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:91, Per-host budget receipts. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: D5 records exact invocation, prelude length, restored clock, W/2W conversion, expected permits, low-clock and high-clock controls, retained tail and terminal reason per fixture and host. Rationale: The compared interval cannot adapt to convenient output or a host-specific shorter stream. Required outcome: Retain measured per-host budgets and the same fixed whole-cycle interval.

**N14 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:96, Nonpassing BLOCKED exit and independent denominators. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: R12, D5 and Exit name every xvic dependency blocked by a non-100000 write clock, retain both host contexts, run all independent obligations and return nonzero from the cumulative target. No blocked case becomes pass or skip; Phase E and done-state remain held. Rationale: Shared ordinary selectors now exclude real cases while the cumulative selection retains them, so reporting independent work does not require accepting blocked xvic fixtures. Required outcome: Keep one-host, both-host and matching classifications with stable case identifiers; never call Phase D COMPLETE while R12 is blocked.

**N15 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:80, Armed checkpoint writer preserves gate interactions. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: D1 gate-double controls require one record/permit per advanced cycle, no advance while a permit is held, unchanged quit/EOF/error behavior and independently measured trigger/write clocks under pending interrupts and stolen runs; D5 repeats both hosts. Rationale: Unset-variable equivalence is no longer used as the sole evidence for an armed writer. Required outcome: Keep both the armed controls and unarmed equivalence rerun with zero VICE_SNAP lines.

**N16 PASS** (high), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:81, Audit interval starts before discovery. Round 6: PASS. Evidence: D2 sets VICESHARP_NATIVE_LOAD"}
